가지다.m: to have, to own; to take, to hold
가지다.ex: 저는 한국 돈을 조금 가지고 있어요.
가지다.x: I have a little Korean money.
가지다.t: Common pattern: 가지고 있다 'to have (on you)'. Often shortened to 갖다.

섬.ex: 배를 타고 한 시간쯤 가면 작은 섬이 있어요.
섬.x: If you take a boat for about an hour, there's a small island.
섬.e: Island names use Sino-Korean -도 instead: 제주도, 독도, 울릉도.

드디어.x: The vacation I'd been waiting for so long has finally started.
드디어.t: 드디어 is for long-awaited results; for 'in the end' (often disappointing) use 결국.

갚다.m: to pay back, to repay; to return (a favor)
갚다.ex: 친구에게 빌린 돈을 다음 주에 갚을 거예요.
갚다.x: I'll pay back the money I borrowed from my friend next week.
갚다.e: Used for kindness too: 은혜를 갚다 = to repay a favor.

땅콩.ex: 저는 땅콩 알레르기가 있어서 늘 조심해요.
땅콩.x: I have a peanut allergy, so I'm always careful.
땅콩.e: 땅 'ground, earth' + 콩 'bean': the bean that grows underground.
땅콩.t: Peanut butter is 땅콩버터. Roasted peanuts are a common snack served with beer (안주).

직장.ex: 직장이 집에서 멀어서 매일 일찍 나가요.
직장.x: My workplace is far from home, so I leave early every day.
직장.t: 직장 means your workplace or job in general; 회사 is specifically a company.

프린터.x: There's no paper at all in the office printer.
프린터.t: To print something, Koreans say 프린트하다 or the more formal 출력하다.

방문객.ex: 주말에는 이 박물관에 방문객이 정말 많아요.
방문객.x: This museum has a lot of visitors on weekends.
방문객.e: Literally 'visiting guest'; -객 = guest or customer: 관광객, 승객.

팬.ex: 저는 그 가수의 오랜 팬이라서 콘서트에 꼭 가요.
팬.x: I'm a longtime fan of that singer, so I always go to the concerts.
팬.e: From English 'fan.' Homonym: 팬 also means frying pan (프라이팬).
팬.t: 팬 is short for 'fanatic'; K-pop fans call fan meetings 팬미팅 and fan signings 팬 사인회.

돌보다.m: to take care of, to look after
돌보다.ex: 주말에는 제가 집에서 어린 조카를 돌봐요.
돌보다.x: On weekends, I look after my little niece at home.
돌보다.e: Probably 돌다 (turn around) + 보다 (look) — keep turning to look after someone.

성공.x: There's a saying that failure is the mother of success.

다투다.m: to argue, to quarrel; to compete (for)
다투다.x: Yesterday I argued with my little brother over a toy.
다투다.e: The noun is 다툼 'quarrel', made with the -ㅁ ending.
다투다.t: 다투다 sounds milder and more formal than 싸우다 and usually means a verbal argument.

경영.ex: 아버지는 은퇴하시면서 형에게 회사 경영을 맡기셨어요.
경영.x: When my father retired, he left the running of the company to my older brother.

한의원.x: I got herbal medicine made at a Korean medicine clinic.
한의원.t: Pronounced [하늬원]; 침을 맞다 is the set phrase for getting acupuncture.

삼키다.m: to swallow; to hold back (tears, words)
삼키다.ex: 이 약은 씹지 말고 물과 함께 삼키세요.
삼키다.x: Don't chew this medicine; swallow it with water.

외치다.x: The crowd shouted the player's name loudly.

독립하다.m: to become independent; to move out (from parents)
독립하다.x: I moved out from my parents' place at twenty.

당일 배송.x: If you order in the morning, it's delivered the same day.
당일 배송.e: 당일 'the very day' + 배송 'delivery' (literally 'distribute and send').
당일 배송.t: Compare 익일 배송 'next-day delivery' and 새벽 배송 'early-morning delivery'.

해열제.x: My child had a fever, so I gave them a fever reducer.
해열제.t: Pronounced [해열쩨] — 제 is tensed after ㄹ.

아이돌.ex: 제 동생은 아이돌이 되고 싶어서 춤을 연습해요.
아이돌.x: My younger sibling wants to become an idol, so they practice dancing.
아이돌.e: From English 'idol'; in Korea it means a trained K-pop singer, usually in a group.

과태료.x: Last week I paid a fine for a parking violation.
과태료.t: 과태료 is an administrative fine (parking, late filing); 벌금 is a criminal fine set by a court.

지자체.ex: 많은 지자체가 지역 축제를 열고 있어요.
지자체.x: Many local governments are holding regional festivals.
지자체.e: Short for 지방 자치 단체 'local self-governing body'.

잠자코.forms: 잠자코 + verb: 잠자코 듣다, 잠자코 있다
잠자코.ex: 그는 아무 말 없이 잠자코 듣기만 했어요.
잠자코.x: He just listened silently without saying a word.

인하다.forms: Mostly as connectors: N(으)로 인해(서) · N(으)로 인하여 · N(으)로 인한 (+noun)
인하다.m: to be due to, to be caused by
인하다.x: The road was closed due to heavy snow.
인하다.t: N(으)로 인해 is the news-style way to say 'due to N'; 때문에 is the everyday version.

걸치다.m: to throw on (clothes), to drape; to span, to extend over
걸치다.x: It was cold, so I draped a blanket over my shoulders.
걸치다.e: Related to 걸다 'to hang': something hung loosely over something else.

눈이 빠지게 기다리다.forms: 눈이 빠지게 기다려요 · 눈이 빠지게 기다렸어요
눈이 빠지게 기다리다.m: to wait eagerly, to wait impatiently for a long time
눈이 빠지게 기다리다.ex: 아이들은 산타 할아버지를 눈이 빠지게 기다렸어요.
눈이 빠지게 기다리다.x: The kids waited impatiently for Santa.
눈이 빠지게 기다리다.e: Literally 'to wait until your eyes fall out' from staring at the door.
눈이 빠지게 기다리다.t: Means the same as 목이 빠지게 기다리다; both stress long, impatient waiting.

손을 떼다.forms: 손을 떼요 · 손을 뗐어요 · N에서 손을 떼다
손을 떼다.m: to wash one's hands of, to quit (a job or affair), to stay out of
손을 떼다.x: He's completely out of politics now.
손을 떼다.e: 떼다 = to detach; literally 'to take one's hands off.'
손을 떼다.t: Usually with -에서: 이 일에서 손을 떼세요, 'Stay out of this.'

스릴러.ex: 밤에 혼자 스릴러를 보니까 좀 무서웠어요.
스릴러.x: Watching a thriller alone at night was a bit scary.
스릴러.t: Crime thrillers are a strong Korean genre. For horror, Koreans say 공포 영화.

손이 모자라다.m: to be short-handed, to not have enough help
손이 모자라다.x: On weekends we have lots of customers, so we're short-handed.
손이 모자라다.e: 손 here means 'working hands, labor': there aren't enough hands for the work.
손이 모자라다.t: Used at shops, restaurants, events and family gatherings; 일손이 모자라다 and 손이 부족하다 mean the same.

상장.ex: 그 회사는 내년에 주식 시장에 상장될 예정이에요.
상장.x: That company is scheduled to be listed on the stock market next year.
상장.e: Literally 'putting up on the market floor'.
상장.t: Watch out for the homonym 상장 meaning an award certificate, common at schools.

재개발.ex: 이 동네는 재개발로 아파트 단지가 될 예정이에요.
재개발.x: This neighborhood is set to become an apartment complex through redevelopment.
재개발.e: Literally 'develop again'; 재- = re-: 재건축, 재활용.
재개발.t: 재개발 redevelops a whole run-down area; 재건축 rebuilds specific old buildings like an apartment complex.

더러는.x: Traveling alone is nice once in a while, too.
더러는.e: From 더러 'some, now and then' + topic marker 는.

신조어.ex: 요즘 젊은 사람들이 쓰는 신조어는 이해하기 어려워요.
신조어.x: The new words young people use these days are hard to understand.

압수수색.ex: 경찰은 오늘 아침 그 회사 본사를 압수수색했습니다.
압수수색.x: Police raided the company's headquarters this morning.
압수수색.e: 압수 'seizure' plus 수색 'search': a raid to search and confiscate.

용역.ex: 청소는 외부 용역 업체에 맡기고 있습니다.
용역.x: We leave the cleaning to an outside contractor.
용역.t: In daily news, 용역 usually means outsourced contract work, as in 용역 업체 'contractor' or 용역 직원 'contract worker.'

우주정거장.ex: 우주인들은 우주정거장에서 여러 달 동안 생활합니다.
우주정거장.x: Astronauts live on the space station for several months.
우주정거장.e: Literally 'outer-space stop'; 정거장 is an everyday word for a bus or train stop.

초현실주의.x: Dalí's paintings are representative works of surrealism.
초현실주의.e: Literally 'beyond-reality-ism' — a direct match for French 'sur-réalisme.'

산문시.ex: 산문시는 행을 나누지 않고 문장처럼 이어서 써요.
산문시.x: A prose poem is written continuously like sentences, without line breaks.
산문시.e: Literally 'scattered-writing poem' — poetry written in paragraphs, not lines.

문학평론.ex: 그는 소설가이면서 문학평론도 꾸준히 쓰고 있어요.
문학평론.x: He is a novelist but also steadily writes literary criticism.
문학평론.t: Pronounced [문학평논]: ㄹ after ㅇ becomes ㄴ (the ㅎ is kept in standard pronunciation).

활자본.m: book printed with movable type, movable-type edition
활자본.ex: 고려 시대에 이미 금속 활자본이 만들어졌습니다.
활자본.x: Books printed with metal movable type were already made in the Goryeo era.
활자본.e: Literally 'living-letter edition' — the type pieces move and can be reused.
활자본.t: Pronounced [활짜본] — the ㅈ after ㄹ is tensed.

친일파.ex: 광복 후에도 친일파를 청산하는 일은 쉽지 않았어요.
친일파.x: Even after liberation, purging the pro-Japanese collaborators was not easy.
친일파.e: Literally 'pro-Japan faction'; -파 = faction or group: 친일파, 개화파.

인간문화재.m: living national treasure (master of an intangible heritage)
인간문화재.x: That grandmother was recognized as a living national treasure of pansori.
인간문화재.e: Literally 'human cultural asset'; officially called a holder of intangible heritage.

세시풍속.ex: 설날에 떡국을 먹는 것은 대표적인 세시풍속이에요.
세시풍속.x: Eating rice cake soup on Lunar New Year is a typical seasonal custom.

촛불집회.ex: 수많은 시민이 광장에 모여 촛불집회를 열었습니다.
촛불집회.x: Countless citizens gathered in the square and held a candlelight rally.
촛불집회.e: 촛불 'candlelight' (초 + 불) plus 집회 'rally'; iconic peaceful protests in modern Korea.

서열화.ex: 대학 서열화는 입시 경쟁을 심하게 만들어요.
서열화.x: Ranking universities makes the admissions race fiercer.
